name: Mt. Gox
rootCause: On June 19, 2011, attackers exploited a SQL injection vulnerability in an undocumented WordPress installation at Mt. Gox, enabling a database leak, brute-forced admin credentials, and direct internal balance manipulation. The incident resulted in a flash crash on the exchange and approximately 2,000 BTC being withdrawn, with much larger on-exchange losses prevented by transaction locking and rapid shutdown. A SQL injection flaw in an unmonitored WordPress instance,sharing database credentials with Mt. Gox’s main exchange,enabled attackers to exfiltrate user and admin credential data.
